high_level_description: This image is a stylized representation of the famous Japanese woodblock print "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" by Katsushika Hokusai. The artwork has been creatively reimagined to fit within a circular frame, giving it a modern and minimalist aesthetic. Setting: The background is entirely black, which makes the central circular design stand out prominently. The circular frame represents the iconic wave from the original painting, but it is simplified and abstracted. Objects: The central object is a large, dynamic wave with white foam at its crest
